title: PaT: Planning-after-Trial for Efficient Test-Time Code Generation
authors_zh: Youngsik Yoon、Sungjae Lee、Seockbean Song、Jungseul Ok（浦项科技大学）；Siwei Wang、Wei Chen（微软亚洲研究院）
paper_type_zh: 验证失败触发的自适应测试时代码生成研究
best_for_zh: 设计带沙箱反馈、且不同模型成本差异显著的代码智能体的读者。
one_line: PaT tries inexpensive direct code generation first and invokes a planner only after all verified trials fail, improving the code-generation cost-performance frontier.
PaT 先用低成本模型直接生成并执行验证，仅在全部失败时才调用规划器分解问题，从而改善代码生成的成本—性能前沿。
why: It uses an executable failure signal, rather than a learned difficulty score, to decide when an expensive reasoning module is worth calling.
inclusion_reason: It uses programmatic verification failure to allocate expensive planning and recursive code-generation computation only where direct sampling is insufficient.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Planning and decomposition can improve difficult code generation, but a planning-before-trial policy charges every task for a planner even when direct generation would already pass. This makes a small model with an elaborate planning pipeline more expensive than a much larger model used directly, while Best-of-N alone can spend samples on candidates that fail for structural reasons.

PaT asks when planning is actually worth its test-time cost. It uses executable feedback as the boundary: try direct programs first, run them against a test set, and invoke planning only when every direct candidate fails. The paper therefore studies allocation between direct generation, verification, and recursive decomposition rather than treating planning as a universal preamble.

规划和分解能够改善困难代码生成，但“先规划再尝试”的策略会让每个任务都支付规划器成本，即使直接生成本已通过。这样，带复杂规划流水线的小模型可能比直接使用的大模型更昂贵；单独的 Best-of-N 也可能把样本花在因结构性原因失败的候选上。

PaT 研究规划何时真正值得测试时成本。它用可执行反馈划定边界：先尝试直接程序，在测试集上运行它们，只有所有直接候选都失败时才调用规划。因而论文研究的是直接生成、验证与递归分解之间的分配，而不把规划当作普遍前序步骤。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core policy is Planning-after-Trial. A generator samples several direct implementations and a sandbox executes them on tests. A fully passing candidate terminates the run immediately. Consistent failure is treated as evidence that the specification exceeds the generator’s direct capability, which is when a planner produces a top-level implementation and subproblem specifications.

Each planned subproblem is solved recursively with the same trial-first rule, and verified helper functions are composed into the final program. This lets PaT pair a cheap generator with a more capable planner: the larger model is not paid for on easy tasks, but is reserved for structural intervention after a concrete verification failure rather than an uncertain learned difficulty prediction.

核心策略是“尝试后规划”。生成器采样若干直接实现，沙箱在测试上执行它们。只要有一个候选全部通过，运行立即结束。持续失败被视为规格超出生成器直接能力的证据，此时规划器产生顶层实现和子问题规格。

每个计划子问题再用同一尝试优先规则递归求解，已验证的辅助函数被组合成最终程序。这样 PaT 可以把廉价生成器与更强规划器配对：简单任务无需支付大模型，结构性干预只在具体验证失败后触发，而不是基于不确定的学习难度预测。

title: Method
方法
html:
Given specification x, the generator first produces a Best-of-N set of direct programs. The system executes every candidate in a sandboxed Python runtime against a test set. If one passes all tests, it returns it. If none pass, the planner decomposes x into subproblems; those are recursively solved, tested, and composed with the planner's top-level implementation.

The evaluation uses HumanEval, MBPP, their EvalPlus variants, and difficulty-stratified xCodeEval, across Qwen3 sizes plus Llama and DeepSeek-Coder models. Results measure Pass@1 and token-price-based inference cost. The heterogeneous setting deliberately uses an efficient small generator and stronger planner, while the homogeneous setting tests whether the policy itself improves the frontier without changing model family.

给定规格 x，生成器先产生一组 Best-of-N 直接程序。系统在沙箱 Python 运行时中，用测试集执行每个候选。若有一个通过全部测试就返回；若都未通过，规划器把 x 分解为子问题，再递归求解、测试这些子问题，并与规划器顶层实现组合。

评测使用 HumanEval、MBPP、其 EvalPlus 变体和按难度划分的 xCodeEval，覆盖多种 Qwen3 规模以及 Llama 和 DeepSeek-Coder 模型。结果衡量 Pass@1 和基于令牌价格的推理成本。异构设置刻意使用高效小生成器和更强规划器；同构设置则检验不改变模型家族时，该策略本身能否改善前沿。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the foundational benchmark average, PaT raises Qwen3-4B from 76.05% for standard inference to 83.13%, at normalized cost 4.85; FunCoder reaches 81.18% at cost 8.31. The paper attributes the difference to avoiding unconditional planning: standard Qwen3-4B directly solves about 76% of these problems, so PaT calls the planner only for the remaining failures.

The heterogeneous configuration is the clearest cost result: it reports performance comparable to a large homogeneous model while reducing inference cost by about 69%. The evidence is strong for code tasks with usable execution tests, but it does not prove that a failed public test set identifies all hard tasks or that passing generated tests predicts hidden-test correctness. The cost calculation also depends on stated market token prices.

在基础基准平均上，PaT 将 Qwen3-4B 从标准推理的 76.05% 提升到 83.13%，归一化成本为 4.85；FunCoder 为 81.18%、成本 8.31。论文将差异归因于避免无条件规划：标准 Qwen3-4B 已直接解决约 76% 的问题，因此 PaT 只为剩余失败调用规划器。

异构配置是最清晰的成本结果：论文报告其性能可与大型同构模型相当，同时将推理成本降低约 69%。证据对具有可用执行测试的代码任务很强，但并未证明失败的公开测试集能识别所有困难任务，也未证明通过生成测试就等于隐藏测试正确。成本计算还依赖所声明的市场令牌价格。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Static code pipelines pay planning or decomposition cost before observing whether it is needed; learned adaptive policies add another model and training burden. PaT changes the allocation trigger to a programmatic event: exhaustive direct-trial failure. The verifier is therefore not merely an evaluator at the end—it decides whether the next expensive reasoning stage should exist at all.

The contribution is not a better planner in isolation. It is a reactive control rule that connects unit-test outcomes to a heterogeneous compute policy and recursive subproblem budget. Its audit boundary is clear: if the tests are weak, correlated with the generator, or unavailable, the failure signal may be a poor difficulty detector and the claimed efficiency advantage can disappear.

静态代码流水线在观察是否需要之前就支付规划或分解成本；学习型自适应策略又增加另一个模型和训练负担。PaT 把分配触发器改为程序化事件：所有直接尝试均失败。因此验证器不再只是末端评估器，它决定下一阶段昂贵推理是否应当存在。

贡献不在于孤立地改进规划器，而在于把单元测试结果连接到异构计算策略和递归子问题预算的反应式控制规则。其审计边界很明确：若测试较弱、与生成器相关或不可用，失败信号可能是糟糕的难度检测器，所声称的效率优势也可能消失。

title: Limitations
局限
html: PaT relies on executable tests being available, representative, and difficult to game. A weak test suite can terminate on a superficially passing program, while an incomplete direct trial can invoke costly planning for a problem that a different sample would solve. Recursive decomposition can also grow the call tree on hard tasks, and reported monetary cost depends on model pricing and serving assumptions. The paper does not link official code or data, so exact prompts and test-generation details require reconstruction from the PDF.
PaT 依赖可执行测试存在、具有代表性且不易被投机。弱测试集可能让表面通过的程序提前结束；不完整的直接尝试也可能让一个本可由不同样本解决的问题进入昂贵规划。递归分解还可能在困难任务上增长调用树，所报告货币成本依赖模型定价和服务假设。论文未链接官方代码或数据，因此确切提示和测试生成细节需从 PDF 重建。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use PaT when a code agent has reliable sandbox feedback and a clear price gap between a fast generator and a strong planner. Log direct candidates, every test result, planning triggers, subproblem depth, planner calls, and hidden-test outcomes. The important deployment comparison is not only Pass@1: measure how often direct trials succeed, how much planner work each failure triggers, and whether equal-cost Best-of-N or static planning would be preferable for the real task mix.
当代码智能体拥有可靠沙箱反馈，且快速生成器与强规划器存在明确价格差距时，可使用 PaT。应记录直接候选、每次测试结果、规划触发、子问题深度、规划器调用和隐藏测试结果。重要的部署比较不只是 Pass@1：还要衡量直接尝试成功频率、每次失败触发多少规划工作，以及在真实任务混合下等成本 Best-of-N 或静态规划是否更合适。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: PaT makes execution failure the compute-allocation signal. Its first stage is direct Best-of-N plus tests; planning and recursion are exception handling for verified failure. The heterogeneous result is meaningful because it reserves the expensive model for a subset of tasks, but its 69% cost figure must be read with the paper's price assumptions. This is a strong example of a programmatic verifier changing not only selection but the entire inference graph.
PaT 把执行失败设为计算分配信号。第一阶段是直接 Best-of-N 加测试；规划和递归是对已验证失败的异常处理。异构结果之所以有意义，是因为昂贵模型只保留给一部分任务，但其 69% 成本数字必须连同论文价格假设一起阅读。这是程序化验证器不仅改变选择，而且改变整个推理图的强例子。
